strongest_findings.finding: A column of three danger-outline Remove buttons is the strongest colour mass on each list page, above and competing with the single orange submit; the phone layouts already use quiet text Remove.

Four pill treatments (on, built-in, off, amber never loaded) plus two equal outline buttons and a quiet header link: no single emphasis in the viewport; mono on/off pills read toggle-like next to an Enable button.
Type/Value pair then View alone under Type leaves the right track empty; each 3-field record spends ~180px.
Precedence note sits under the Add record button at the page edge rather than in the form column near its fields (unchanged from R3).
Second KPI strip and Metric table restate counts; orange Forwarded series echoes the accent (owner declined recolour/deletion; recorded, not re-argued).

Brand-fit only: account region shows role but no signed-in name and a full-width Sign out; phone wordmark subtitle reads "Scroll navigation". Differs from KyIdentity reference; navigation redesign is a retained limit.

strengths: Sign-in (8.7) and Appearance (8.3) are the strongest; the picker matches the KyIdentity reference card for card.
R3 findings were answered in visible pixels: neutral list-header jump links, 13px row meta, slash-break source URL, label-over-value phone tracks with Remove beside the name.
One 240px left navigation region with accent-rail selection on every signed-in page; one flat surface; orange limited to submit, selection and focus except the Discovered link and Forwarded series.

recommended_batch.why: Progression line unmet (7.8(3) exact vs 7.95 needed) and findings 1-4 are concrete, product-local and do not touch shared tokens, routes, copy or behaviour.
recommended_batch.scope: One bounded list-page consistency batch; no new features, no shared danger/accent override, no navigation/Settings redesign, no empty-state filler, no chart recolour.
items: Records/Services desktop: render row Remove as the same quiet danger text button the phone layout uses (keep 40px target, danger hue and existing POST/confirmation).
Blacklists: one status vocabulary - plain text state with at most one neutral pill per row; keep the amber warning only for the never-loaded/error state.
Records phone: place View beside Type (or Value full-width with Type|View paired) so both tracks fill.
Records desktop: move the precedence note into the form column above the submit.
recommended_batch.expected_effect: Not predicted. Outcome unknown until recaptured and blind-scored. No demand for further rounds on individual screens.
